summary: Skyasterix explains how to optimize and build Solmo ('Shieldzilla') for the Season 8 Temporal Vortex battle against Arbor Hydra. Solmo generates massive team-wide shields that scale directly with Enlightenment, making Enlightenment the essential stat for team survivability. The creator recommends a 2-2-1-2 talent setup featuring Golden Touch to sustain HP, equipping the Orb of the Dragon God artifact, and strictly setting Solmo's ultimate skill timing to a 24.0-second initial cast. Diantha is used alongside Solmo, with careful positioning and timing adjustments to maximize boss challenge damage.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: Provides massive team-wide shields scaling on Enlightenment; requires high Enlightenment, 2-2-1-2 talents with Golden Touch, and a strict 24.0s ultimate timing.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.note: Paired with Solmo against Arbor Hydra, placed either frontline or backline with an ultimate timing tested around 15.8s to 16.0s.

teams.note: Solmo is positioned in the back corner (or middle) with Diantha in front; Solmo uses Orb of the Dragon God with ultimate timed at 24.0s initial and 18.0s recast.

tips: Prioritize Enlightenment gear on Solmo; lower Enlightenment directly reduces shield capacity and risks team survival.
Use a 2-2-1-2 talent path on Solmo, choosing Golden Touch (restores 5% HP on buff loss/refresh) and avoiding Sandstorm's Passage which is useless in Temporal Vortex.
Do not alter Solmo's ultimate timing from a 24.0-second first cast (18.0-second recast) against Arbor Hydra.
Test Diantha's initial ultimate timing between 15.8s and 16.0s to align properly with boss mechanics.
Equip Orb of the Dragon God on Solmo to boost defense and shield value.
title: Solmo + Vortex = SHIELDZILLA?! 💥 INSANE BUILD | Dragonheir: Silent Gods
